# wwe2k16 - the native renderer build: WWE 2K16 on the WWE 2K14 SDK (ReXGlue v0.10.0 + the WWE 2K14 port's 118 SDK
# patches, tools/native-stage1.sh) instead of this project's ReXGlue 0.7. Same app code (src/, which compiles on both:
# src/ppc_compat.h), the code generated by 0.10 (generated_k14/), and the SDK as an installed package: librexruntime.so
# (linked) and librexgpu-xenos.so (the GPU plugin, loaded at run time).
#
# Android:  tools/android-build-k14.sh (builds the SDK for arm64, then this, then the APK)
# Host:     cmake -S native -B out/build-k14 -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<SDK install>   (a Linux build, for checking)
#
# No codegen step here: generated_k14/ comes from tools/native-stage1.sh on the host (the Android SDK install's
# code generator is an Android binary).

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(wwe2k16 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

get_filename_component(WWE2K16_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.." ABSOLUTE)
set(WWE2K16_GENERATED "${WWE2K16_ROOT}/generated_k14")

# Clang < 19 with GCC 13's libstdc++ (host builds only): std::expected needs __cpp_concepts >= 202002L.
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang" AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION VERSION_LESS 19 AND NOT ANDROID)
    set(_wwe2k16_cxx20 "$<AND:$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>,$<VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL:$<TARGET_PROPERTY:CXX_STANDARD>,20>>")
    add_compile_options("$<${_wwe2k16_cxx20}:-D__cpp_concepts=202002L>" "$<${_wwe2k16_cxx20}:-Wno-builtin-macro-redefined>")
endif()

find_package(rexglue 0.10.0 REQUIRED CONFIG)
message(STATUS "wwe2k16 native: ReXGlue ${REXGLUE_VERSION_STRING}, generated code in ${WWE2K16_GENERATED}")

if(NOT EXISTS "${WWE2K16_GENERATED}/sources.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "generated_k14/sources.cmake is missing: run tools/native-stage1.sh first (it recompiles the game "
                        "with the WWE 2K14 SDK's code generator)")
endif()
include("${WWE2K16_GENERATED}/sources.cmake")  # GENERATED_SOURCES (absolute paths)

# --- The recompiled game (generated_k14/) ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# No debug info for the ~80k recompiled functions unless asked (-DWWE2K16_RECOMP_DEBUG=ON): it is most of the build's
# disk use.
option(WWE2K16_RECOMP_DEBUG "Line tables for the recompiled code" OFF)
set(WWE2K16_RECOMP_OPTIONS "")
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    if(WWE2K16_RECOMP_DEBUG)
        list(APPEND WWE2K16_RECOMP_OPTIONS -gline-tables-only)
    else()
        list(APPEND WWE2K16_RECOMP_OPTIONS -g0)
    endif()
endif()
add_library(wwe2k16_recomp OBJECT ${GENERATED_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(wwe2k16_recomp PRIVATE "${WWE2K16_GENERATED}" "${WWE2K16_ROOT}/src")
target_link_libraries(wwe2k16_recomp PRIVATE rex::runtime)
rexglue_apply_target_settings(wwe2k16_recomp)
target_precompile_headers(wwe2k16_recomp PRIVATE "${WWE2K16_GENERATED}/wwe2k16_pch.h")
target_compile_options(wwe2k16_recomp PRIVATE ${WWE2K16_RECOMP_OPTIONS})
set_target_properties(wwe2k16_recomp PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# --- The app (src/) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(WWE2K16_SOURCES
    main.cpp
    disc_image.cpp
    test_input.cpp
    resolve_coherency.cpp
    frame_rate.cpp
    launcher_settings.cpp
    screenshot.cpp
    fps_overlay.cpp
    shadows.cpp
    cp_profiler.cpp
    exit_menu.cpp
    display_refresh_rate.cpp
    frame_monitor.cpp
    android_driver.cpp
    touch_input.cpp
    native_renderer.cpp
    dlc_install.cpp
    integrity.cpp
)
# achievement_toast.cpp is left out: the 0.10 SDK draws its own achievement pop-ups (rex/ui/overlay/achievement_*).
list(TRANSFORM WWE2K16_SOURCES PREPEND "${WWE2K16_ROOT}/src/")

if(ANDROID)
    add_library(wwe2k16 SHARED ${WWE2K16_SOURCES})
    set_target_properties(wwe2k16 PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME main)
else()
    add_executable(wwe2k16 ${WWE2K16_SOURCES})
endif()
target_include_directories(wwe2k16 PRIVATE "${WWE2K16_GENERATED}" "${WWE2K16_ROOT}/src")
target_link_libraries(wwe2k16 PRIVATE wwe2k16_recomp rex::runtime)
target_compile_definitions(wwe2k16 PRIVATE WWE2K16_NATIVE_BUILD=1)
# The SDL entry point (SDL_main on Android) and ReXApp, the GPU plugin copied next to the app.
rexglue_configure_target(wwe2k16 GPU_PLUGINS xenos)

if(ANDROID)
    # The guest's floating point is unfused on the console: keep a*b+c unfused here too (as the 2K14 port does).
    target_compile_options(wwe2k16 PRIVATE -ffp-contract=off)
    target_compile_options(wwe2k16_recomp PRIVATE -ffp-contract=off)
    target_link_libraries(wwe2k16 PRIVATE android log)
    target_link_options(wwe2k16 PRIVATE "LINKER:-z,noexecstack")
    # Custom Vulkan drivers (src/android_driver.cpp): libadrenotools (BSD-2-Clause); its hook libraries go into the APK.
    set(WWE2K16_ADRENOTOOLS "${WWE2K16_ROOT}/thirdparty/libadrenotools")
    if(EXISTS "${WWE2K16_ADRENOTOOLS}/CMakeLists.txt")
        if(NOT CMAKE_ANDROID_ARCH_ABI)
            set(CMAKE_ANDROID_ARCH_ABI ${ANDROID_ABI})
        endif()
        add_subdirectory("${WWE2K16_ADRENOTOOLS}" adrenotools EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
        target_link_libraries(wwe2k16 PRIVATE adrenotools)
        target_compile_definitions(wwe2k16 PRIVATE WWE2K16_HAVE_ADRENOTOOLS=1)
        add_dependencies(wwe2k16 hook_impl main_hook)
    else()
        message(WARNING "thirdparty/libadrenotools is missing: custom GPU drivers are off in this build")
    endif()
endif()
